title: 割代价与平衡
Cut cost and balance
description: 在五节点图上逐条算割代价，再检验面积容量。
Count crossing edges on a five-vertex graph, then check area capacity.

caption: 每个节点恰好属于一组，两组都要有节点。
Assign each vertex once and keep both groups nonempty.
全放在一侧时，cut 是 0，但另一侧为空。
Putting everything on one side gives cut 0 and an empty part.
从 AE | BCD 出发，只把连接不同组的边加入和式。
For AE | BCD, add weights only when the endpoints belong to different groups.
每条无向边只算一次。割代价为 5 + 1 + 1 + 5 = 12。
Count each undirected edge once. The cut is 5 + 1 + 1 + 5 = 12.

title: 人数相同，连接质量不同
Same counts, different cut

caption: 改成 ABC | DE，只有 CD 和 CE 跨组。
Switch to ABC | DE. Only CD and CE cross the cut.
两种方案都是两点与三点，cut 从 12 降到 3。
Both splits have a two-vertex and a three-vertex part. The cut drops from 12 to 3.

heading: 相同人数分布下的割代价
Cut costs at the same count split

caption: 把 A 的面积改成 4。节点数没变，ABC 的面积变成 6。
Set A’s area to 4. The counts stay fixed while the area of ABC grows to 6.
每组容量为 4 时，ABC 超出容量。先拒绝这份方案，再比较 cut。
At capacity 4, ABC overflows. Check feasibility before comparing cuts.

title: 带着指标做实验
Take the metrics into the lab

caption: 默认面积为 1 时，面积比是 2/3，面积不平衡度是 0.2。
With unit areas, the area ratio is 2/3 and normalized imbalance is 0.2.

name: 最小面积 ÷ 最大面积
Minimum area / maximum area

caption: 在实验里移动一个点，先预测哪些边会跨组，再检查组面积。
In the lab, move a vertex. Predict the crossing edges, then check both part areas.

title: 初始二分
Initial bisection
description: 用相同人数约束比较随机、顺序贪心和区域生长。
Compare random, sequential greedy and region growing under the same count target.

caption: 五个点分成两点和三点。先找到可行起点，再讨论质量。
Split five vertices into parts of two and three. Establish a feasible start, then compare quality.
三种方法使用同一张图和同一人数目标，便于比较构造过程。
The three methods share one graph and one count target, so we can compare their decisions.
种子 7 给出顺序 D、B、C、E、A。前两个点放左边。
Seed 7 gives the order D, B, C, E, A. Put the first two on the left.
得到 BD | ACE，cut 为 16。改变种子会得到另一种起点。
The split BD | ACE costs 16. Try another seed for a different start.
按字母顺序处理节点。A 已在左侧，比较 B 放到两侧的新增割边权重。
Visit vertices alphabetically. With A on the left, compare B’s added cut on either side.
B 放左侧后，左组满员。后续节点只看仍有名额的右组。
B fills the left part. Subsequent vertices use the remaining space on the right.
以 A 为起点，对未选节点计算它们连向左组的权重和。
Start at A and sum each unselected vertex’s edge weights into the left part.
B 的分数最高，加入左组，得到 AB | CDE。
B has the strongest connection. Adding it gives AB | CDE.

title: 起点还可以改进
A starting split can be refined

caption: 本例中贪心和生长都得到 cut 5。精确对照的 cut 为 3。
Greedy and growing both cost 5 here. Exact enumeration gives 3.
进入实验，先预测选择，再改种子或边权。下一章用交换改进起点。
Predict the next choice, then vary the seed or edge weights. Next, refine the start with swaps.

title: Kernighan–Lin 成对交换
Kernighan–Lin pair swaps
description: 走完一轮配对试探、锁定和最佳前缀回退。
Follow a complete pass of trial swaps, locks and rollback to the best prefix.

caption: 起点 AE | BCD 的 cut 是 12。每次选一左一右，试着交换。
The starting split AE | BCD costs 12. Try exchanging one vertex from each part.
一进一出保持人数。面积不同的节点换侧时，仍要单独检查组面积。
One in and one out preserve counts. If vertex sizes differ, check the part areas separately.
D 值等于外部权重减内部权重。配对时还要减去两倍共享边权。
D is external minus internal weight. For a pair, also subtract twice their shared edge weight.
这一轮先选 A 与 D。两点间无边，配对增益为 9。
A and D win the first choice. They share no edge, and the gain is 9.

title: 试探与锁定
Try the swap and lock the pair

caption: A 与 D 交换后，cut 变为 3。这两个点在本轮锁定。
Swapping A and D takes the cut to 3. Both vertices are locked for this pass.
剩余点还要重新评分。下一对增益是 −8，作为试探仍可以执行。
Re-score the remaining vertices. The next gain is −8 and can still be tried.

title: 保留累计收益最高的前缀
Keep the best cumulative prefix

caption: 累计收益依次是 0、9、1。第一步结束时最高。
The cumulative gains are 0, 9, 1. The first swap gives the best prefix.
撤回第二步，只保留第一步。接受方案的 cut 是 3。
Undo the second trial and keep the first. The accepted cut is 3.

title: 在实验中回放
Replay the pass in the lab

caption: 空前缀的累计收益是零。只有正收益前缀能改进这一轮。
The empty prefix has gain zero. An improving pass requires a positive prefix.
在实验里逐步播放，分别记录试探中的 cut 和回退后接受的 cut。
Step through the lab and record the trial cuts and the accepted cut separately.

title: Fiduccia–Mattheyses 单点移动
Fiduccia–Mattheyses vertex moves
description: 按人数差过滤候选，观察单点增益更新、锁定和最佳前缀。
Filter moves by count balance, then watch gains, locks and the best prefix update.

caption: FM 一次移动一个点。两组需非空，默认人数差最多为 1。
FM moves one vertex at a time. Keep both parts nonempty and their count difference at most 1.
A 和 E 的收益都高，但会造成 1 比 4。合法候选里 D 的收益最高。
A and E score highly but leave counts 1 and 4. D leads the legal candidates.

title: 移动 D 会改变哪些边
What changes when D moves?

caption: D–E 从跨组变为组内，贡献正收益。D–C 变成跨组，抵消部分收益。
D–E becomes internal, adding gain. D–C becomes crossing and offsets some of it.
D 移动后被锁定。cut 从 12 降到 9，A 现在可以移动。
Lock D after its move. The cut drops from 12 to 9, and A becomes legal.
A 移动贡献 6，试探 cut 降到 3。锁定名单加入 A。
A contributes 6 and lowers the trial cut to 3. Add A to the locks.
接下来试探 C，收益为 −2。暂时变差的状态仍属于本轮轨迹。
The trial move of C gains −2. The pass can temporarily get worse.

title: 最佳前缀决定保留哪些移动
The best prefix selects accepted moves

caption: 累计收益峰值是 9，出现在第 2 步。
The cumulative gain peaks at 9 after 2 moves.

heading: 累计增益含空前缀
Cumulative gain including the empty prefix

caption: 恢复到前两步之后。最终接受 DE | ABC，cut 为 3。
Restore the state after the first two moves. Accept DE | ABC with cut 3.

title: 到实验里改变平衡窗口
Vary the balance window in the lab

caption: 严格等人数时，单点换侧会破坏等式。KL 的成对交换仍保持人数。
Under strict equal counts, a single move breaks equality. A KL pair swap preserves the counts.
在实验里改人数差阈值，观察合法候选和最佳前缀随之改变。
Change the allowed count gap and observe the legal candidates and best prefix in the lab.

title: 谱二分
Spectral bisection
description: 从拉普拉斯矩阵构造谱排序，再扫描可行切口。
Build a spectral order from the Laplacian and sweep feasible cuts.

caption: 把边权填入邻接矩阵。每一行的权重和给出该点的加权度。
Put edge weights into the adjacency matrix. Each row sum gives the weighted degree.
拉普拉斯 L = D − A。对角线是度，非对角项是负边权，每行和为零。
The Laplacian L = D − A has degrees on the diagonal, negative edge weights elsewhere and zero row sums.

title: 把向量变成排序
Turn the vector into an order

caption: 取第二小特征值对应的向量，每个节点获得一个坐标。
Take an eigenvector for the second-smallest eigenvalue. Each vertex gets one coordinate.
按坐标从小到大，顺序为 E、D、C、B、A。向量翻号会把顺序反过来。
Sort the coordinates to get E, D, C, B, A. Negating the vector reverses this order.
沿排序尝试相邻点之间的切口。两侧要满足给定人数窗口。
Try gaps between consecutive vertices. Both parts must meet the count window.
本例合法前缀的 cut 依次为 6、3、5、6。保留最小项。
The legal prefix costs are 6, 3, 5, 6. Choose the lowest-cost entry.
在第 2 个点之后切开。得到 DE | ABC，cut 为 3。
Cut after vertex 2: DE | ABC, with cut 3.
这个结果来自一条谱排序的扫描。小图可再用精确枚举校准。
The result comes from sweeping one spectral order. Check small instances against exact enumeration.

title: 用实验改变输入
Change the input in the lab

caption: 断连图可能有多个零特征值，此时排序方向可能不唯一。
A disconnected graph can have several zero eigenvalues, so its ordering direction can be non-unique.
调整人数窗口，检查切口是否合法。下一章把二分用到选中的子图。
Vary the count window and check which cuts remain legal. Next, bisect a selected subgraph.

title: 递归二分
Recursive bisection
description: 在诱导子图上重算二分，并累计全图新增跨边。
Recompute splits on induced subgraphs and add newly crossing edges in the full graph.

caption: 目标是三组。先把全部节点作为一个待拆分的组。
Aim for three parts. Start with all vertices together in one part.
每轮挑选人数最多的组。人数相同时按组编号选，保证结果可复现。
At each step, choose the largest part by vertex count. Break ties by part ID.
谱二分先得到 DE | ABC。全图 cut 增加 3。
Spectral bisection gives DE | ABC and adds 3 to the full-graph cut.
现在 ABC 人数最多。下一次只保留 ABC 内部的节点和边。
ABC is now the largest part. The next solve uses only its vertices and internal edges.

title: 子图重新计算谱排序
Recompute the order inside the subgraph

caption: ABC 子图重算后的谱顺序为 C、B、A，切出 C 和 AB。
The recomputed order is C, B, A, separating C from AB.
这一步新增 5。DE 仍是原来的组，先前的跨边继续计入总和。
This split adds 5. DE stays together, and earlier crossing edges still count.
全图 cut 从 0 到 3，再到 8。每条边在首次分开时计入。
The full-graph cut rises from 0 to 3 to 8. Count each edge when first separated.

heading: 每次分裂后的全图 cut
Full-graph cut after each split

caption: 局部窗口只约束眼前的二分。最终三组的面积要重新检查。
A local window constrains the current split. Check the areas of the final three parts separately.

title: 在分裂树上定位变化
Find the changes in the split tree

caption: 回看第一次分裂，再查看 ABC 的子图。试着标出第二次新增的跨边。
Replay the first split, then inspect ABC. Identify the edges newly cut by the second split.
下一章用相同容量约束比较递归、轮转和交换改进。
Next, compare recursion, round robin and swap refinement under a common capacity.

title: 多路划分
Multiway partitioning
description: 在同一容量约束下比较轮转、递归、交换和精确小图对照。
Compare round robin, recursion, swaps and an exact small-graph reference under one capacity.

caption: 本例目标三组，每组非空，面积容量为 2。先检验容量，再比较 cut。
Use three nonempty parts with area capacity 2. Verify capacity before comparing cuts.
所有方法用同一张 G01。结果需要为每个节点指定唯一组号。
Every method uses the same G01. Each result must assign every vertex to exactly one part.
轮转按输入顺序轮流放入三组，得到 AD | BE | C。
Round robin assigns input vertices cyclically, giving AD | BE | C.
递归先看图结构，在本例得到 DE | C | AB。两种分组都符合容量。
Recursion uses graph structure and gives DE | C | AB. Both starts meet capacity here.
对两组间的候选节点做一进一出。先验面积容量，再比较 cut 的下降。
Consider swapping two vertices from different parts. Check area capacity, then compare cut gains.
这里最佳合法交换仍无正收益，算法停在当前分组。
Here even the best legal swap has no positive gain, so the search stops at its current split.
轮转 cut 为 18，递归和交换改进在此例都是 8。
Round robin costs 18. Recursion and swap refinement both cost 8 on this input.

heading: 同一约束下的割代价
Cut costs under the same constraint

caption: 精确枚举检查了 15 个可行无标号分组，最小 cut 是 8。
Exact enumeration checks 15 feasible unlabeled partitions. The minimum cut is 8.

title: 改变面积再做对照
Change an area and compare again

caption: 容量按面积计算。改动单点面积后，即使人数不变，也要复核各组。
Capacity uses area. Change a vertex size and recheck the parts even when counts stay fixed.
到比较台重跑三种构造方法。记录输入、容量、可行性和 cut。
Re-run the three methods in the comparison lab. Record the input, capacity, feasibility and cut.
